items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Was Celestan as old as you or not? ... Celestan was older than me.

ctx.x: I thought maybe they played with some brass bands here or something.
No, no. No, no. No, no. I never did. Was Celestan as old as you or not? Well, you know, in the beginning I thought he was, but when he died he wasn't. I see.
He died. He grew younger instead of older.
